presets.title: Implement Carefully
presets.prompt: Implement the requested change and verify the result locally before handing it back.
presets.constraints: Preserve unrelated changes. Keep the implementation small and native to the existing architecture. Do not publish or deploy unless explicitly requested.

presets.title: Diagnose Only
presets.prompt: Investigate the reported problem and explain the most likely root cause with concrete evidence.
presets.constraints: Do not modify files or external state. Clearly separate confirmed facts from hypotheses.

presets.title: Review Current Changes
presets.prompt: Review the current changes for correctness, regressions, security issues, and missing tests.
presets.constraints: Prioritize actionable findings. Do not make changes unless asked after the review.
